$comment: Entry schema for contributes.services (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_services.go. A service names a capability (service) the plugin provides through one of its contributes.actions; the action must not be aiCallable and its risk becomes the service's risk. Text input needs the action's maxPayloadBytes to be at least input.maxBytes + {{limits.envelopeReserveBytes}}. The fileMenu and selection surfaces need no workspace.read: the provider only gets what the user picked there (a snapshot token or the selected text, never a path). Host 0.3.0 adds the sftpFile, dbResult and httpResponse surfaces (file and files input; one file each: the remote file, result.json or response.<ext>) and terminalSelection (text input); they are never part of the default and must be listed explicitly. An entry offered on dbResult must accept result.json: its accepts must include .json, application/json or application/*. The provider envelope may then carry surfaceContext; identifying fields in it need remote.context (remote, request) or database.schema (database).
description: Services: named capabilities (for example text.translate or image.ocr) other plugins and MinCode itself can call through a fixed input/output shape.

service.description: Capability name, unique within the plugin. The first segments mincode, host and plugin are reserved.

action.description: One of this plugin's contributes.actions ids; it must not be aiCallable.

accepts.description: Required for file and files input: extensions (.png) or MIME types (image/*, application/pdf), matched case-insensitively and stored lower-cased.

maxBytes.description: text: default {{limits.textDefaultBytes}}, at most {{limits.textMaxBytes}}; file/files: per file, default and at most {{limits.fileMaxBytes}}.

mime.description: Optional MIME type of text or file output.

params.description: Optional extra parameters in the command form dialect (root object, string/integer/number/boolean properties), at most {{limits.paramsMaxBytes}} bytes and {{limits.paramsMaxProperties}} properties.

surfaces.description: Where MinCode offers the service; defaults to the surfaces among fileMenu, selection and palette compatible with the input kind (text: selection, palette, terminalSelection; file/files: fileMenu, palette, sftpFile, dbResult, httpResponse; none: palette). sftpFile, dbResult, httpResponse and terminalSelection need MinCode 0.3.0 and must be listed explicitly. An empty list means plugin callers only.
